title: Partial derivatives, domains and level curves
intro: Read this before the questions on functions of two variables.

blocks.title: partial derivatives
blocks.body: For $f(x,y)$, the partial derivative $f_x=\dfrac{\partial f}{\partial x}$ is found by differentiating with respect to $x$ while treating $y$ as a **constant**. Likewise for $f_y$.

blocks.title: useful results
items: $f_{xy}=f_{yx}$ when the second derivatives are continuous

blocks.title: domains and level curves
blocks.body: The domain is a region of the plane. A **level curve** is the set where $f(x,y)=c$ for a constant $c$. For $x^2+y^2=c$ the level curves are circles.

blocks.title: the slips
items: Do not treat $y$ as a variable when finding $f_x$.
